items.title: 9.9 External (bahar ki) electric field se shielding (bachao) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9 with Fig. 9.19 (PDF 207-208).

blocks.text: English scientist Michael Faraday ne 1836 mein ek structure (dhancha) banaya jise Faraday cage ya Faraday shield kehte hain. Faraday cage conductor (metal) ka bana aisa enclosure (ghera) hai jo bahar ki electric fields ko andar nahi aane deta. Yeh hollow (khokhle) conductor ki tarah kaam karta hai jis ke andar devices (aalaat) ya cheezein bahar ki electric fields se bachane ke liye rakhi ja sakti hain. Cage ko lagne wala bijli ka jhatka (shock) us ki bahar wali surface se guzar jata hai aur andar nuqsan nahi karta. Khokhle conductor ke andar electric field zero rehti hai.

Faraday cage ka kaam samajhne ke liye maan lein conductor ke ek tukre (maslan copper) par kuch excess (zaroorat se zyada) free electrons hain. Har electron par padosi electrons ki field ki wajah se dhakelne wali (repulsive) force lagti hai. Nateeja: saare excess electrons conductor ki surface par chale jate hain. Jab saara excess charge surface par pohanch kar static equilibrium ban jaye to charge ki aur motion (harkat) ruk jati hai. Agar ragar (friction) waghaira se kuch electrons conductor se kisi aur cheez par chale jayein to conductor ki surface par net positive (musbat) charge reh jata hai. Is liye hum keh sakte hain:

blocks.title: Conductor par charge
blocks.text: Electrostatic conditions (halaat) mein equilibrium par conductor ka har excess charge us ki surface par rehta hai.
Ab khokhle conductor ke andar dekhein. Excess charges surface par theek is tarah arrange ho jate hain ke andar kul field zero ho jati hai. Doosre lafzon mein:

blocks.title: Shielding (bachao)
blocks.text: Conductor apne andar rakhe har charge ko bahar ki electric fields se bacha leta hai.
Bahar ki fields ki interference (dakhal) khatam karne ke liye circuits ko aksar metal (dhaat) ke dabbon mein band kiya jata hai jo aisi fields se bachate hain.
Fig. 9.19 dikhati hai ke conductor bahar ke charges ki field lines ko kaise badal deta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen + plate aur daen - plate ke darmiyan khokhla gol conductor. Us ke baen hisse par negative (manfi) aur daen hisse par positive charges. Magenta lines baen se daen, mur kar surface se right angle (90°) par milti hain; andar koi line nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.19 (kitab ki Figure 9.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bahar ki field free electrons ko + plate wali taraf kheenchti hai, is liye conductor ki baen taraf negative aur daen taraf positive charge jama hota hai. Yeh charges andar ki field khatam kar dete hain, aur bahar lines surface par seedhi (perpendicular) milti hain.

Lines is liye badalti hain ke equilibrium mein conductor ki surface ke bilkul bahar field surface ke seedha (perpendicular) hoti hai. Agar field seedhi na hoti to us ka ek hissa surface ke parallel (mutawazi) hota. Surface ke free electrons hil sakte hain, is liye woh is parallel hisse ki force se chal parte. Magar equilibrium mein electrons ka koi flow (bahao) nahi hota. Is liye parallel hissa ho hi nahi sakta, aur field surface ke seedha hoti hai.

Faraday cage ke liye aisa material chahiye jis mein bohat se free electrons hon jo azaadi se surface tak ja sakein. Sirf conductors mein free electrons hote hain; insulators mein nahi hote. Is liye insulators se Faraday cage nahi banaya ja sakta.

Daily life (rozmarra zindagi) mein Faraday cage ki achhi misal gari (car) hai. Toofan (thunderstorm) mein gari ka chassis aur metal frame andar baithe logon ko bachata hai: bijli ka charge gari ki metal ki surface par se guzar kar zameen mein chala jata hai aur andar passengers (musafir) tak nahi pohanchta.

Microwave oven ki metal body bhi Faraday cage ka kaam karta hai: yeh microwaves ko oven se bahar environment (mahaul) mein phailne nahi deta. Airplane (hawai jahaz) ka metal frame bhi Faraday cage hai. Jab jahaz par lightning (aasmani bijli) girti hai to bijli us ke metal frame ki surface par phail jati hai, aur andar passengers aur saare devices safe (mehfooz) rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Faraday cage kin materials se banaya ja sakta hai, aur kyun (short question 9.9)? Hawai jahaz jaisa conductor hawa mein udte hue charge kaise hasil karta hai (short question 9.1)?
blocks.explanation: Conductors se, jaise metals (copper, aluminium, steel ki jaali), kyun ke un mein free electrons hote hain jo surface par ja kar tab tak arrange ho jate hain jab tak andar field zero na ho jaye; insulators mein free electrons nahi hote, is liye woh yeh kaam nahi kar sakte. Udta hua jahaz hawa, gard, pani ke qatron aur barf ke particles (zarra) se ragarta hai; yeh ragar electrons ek jagah se doosri jagah le jati hai, is liye jahaz ka body (jism) charged ho jata hai aur charge us ki bahar wali metal ki surface par phail jata hai.

items: Faraday cage (1836): khokhla conductor; excess charge surface par rehta hai aur aise arrange ho jata hai ke andar field zero ho.
Conductor ki surface ke bilkul bahar field surface ke seedha (perpendicular) hoti hai.
Sirf free electrons wale conductors se cage banta hai. Misalein: toofan mein gari, microwave oven, bijli girne par hawai jahaz, circuits ke gird metal ke dabbe.
